honest_summary: crates/pi-ai/src/providers/anthropic.rs is written in full (3313 lines, 38 unit tests, no todo!/stub bodies): every exported and internal TS function has an identifiable Rust counterpart, and string literals, JSON field names, defaults, ordering and error messages are copied from the TypeScript. The @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.91.1 request path is rebuilt locally with reqwest (URL join, stainless header set/merge order, apiKeyAuth+bearerAuth, APIError text and stream-failure classification) plus a local SSE and streaming-UTF-8 decoder, so the emitted AssistantMessageEvent sequence matches the TS. github_copilot_headers.rs, opencode_headers.rs and cloudflare.rs were skipped because the lead had already written them; anthropic.rs consumes them exactly as documented. I did not run cargo, so residual compile errors in my file beyond the two lead-reported ones are unverified; I did verify the file parses and contains no unmatched delimiters with a standalone rustc parse.
